meaning.en: (medicine) A condition resulting from accumulation of blood in the pleural cavity.
meaning.vi: (y học) Một tình trạng do tích tụ máu trong khoang màng phổi.

sentences.en: No severe complications such as infection, excessive bleeding, hemothorax, aeroembolism, needle track implantation metastasis occurred.

sentences.en: Simple pneumothorax or hemothorax , fractured ribs, and pulmonary contusion may compromise ventilation to a lesser degree and are usually identified in the secondary survey.

sentences.en: It is also reliable to diagnose non-traumatic hemothorax by chest CT.

sentences.en: Echocardiography revealed massive right hemothorax which severely compressed the right atrium and right ventricle.

sentences.en: Traumatic hemothorax is common after traffic accident. However, the association of massive traumatic hemothorax and thoracic vertebral fracture has been rarely reported.
sentences.vi: Tràn máu màng phổi do chấn thương thường gặp sau tai nạn giao thông. Tuy nhiên, mối liên quan của tràn máu màng phổi do chấn thương lớn và gãy đốt sống ngực hiếm khi được báo cáo.

sentences.en: Treatment of patients with pneumothorax and hemothorax is mainly by insertion of a chest tube.
